How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NCBS Senior Project Manager (CIFF) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 25-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NCBS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCBS Senior Project Manager (CIFF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Senior Project Manager (CIFF) position at NCBS is 25th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in any biological science discipline or an M.E/M.Tech or equivalent with at least 50% marks, or a Ph.D. in a relevant subject. Additionally, five years of post-doctoral experience in Microscopy or Flow Cytometry is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the NCBS Senior Project Manager (CIFF) position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Senior Project Manager (CIFF) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Project Manager (CIFF) position is 55 years as of 1st July 2026. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Senior Project Manager (CIFF) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Project Manager (CIFF) post at NCBS will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q6. What is the nature of the job? Is it permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The job for the Senior Project Manager (CIFF) position at NCBS is on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Project Manager (CIFF) recruitment is Bengaluru, Karnataka. Candidates selected will be posted in this city.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Karnataka apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, the notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Candidates from all over India who meet the eligibility criteria can apply for this position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for the Senior Project Manager (CIFF) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Project Manager (CIFF) position will be a consolidated pay, determined based on the candidate's qualifications and experience, in accordance with institutional guidelines.

faq.answer: You can find the official notification link in the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the official notification thoroughly before applying to understand all requirements.
